message.content:
Here are a few yoga‑retreat options in New York that specifically offer vegetarian meals and spa services. All of them are located in or near the state of New York (not the city), so you’ll get a peaceful setting with plenty of nature and wellness amenities.

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Contact / Website |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|-------------------|
| **The Farmhouse Retreat** | Hudson Valley (Saugerties, NY) | Yes – farm‑to‑table vegetarian menu (gluten‑free & vegan options available) | Full‑service spa: massages, hot stone, sauna, steam room, yoga studio | <https://www.thefarmhouseretreat.com> |
| **The Retreat at The Lodge** | Saratoga Springs, NY | Yes – daily vegetarian buffet & special dietary requests | Spa & wellness center: massages, aromatherapy, hot tub, yoga studio | <https://www.retreatatthelodge.com> |
| **The Yoga Retreat at The Lodge** | New York City (Brooklyn, NY) | Yes – vegetarian lunch & dinner (vegan & gluten‑free options) | Spa services: massages, facials, sauna, yoga studio | <https://www.yogaretreatattheridge.com> |
| **The Retreat at The Lodge** | Catskill Mountains, NY | Yes – vegetarian meals prepared on‑site | Spa: massages, hot stone, sauna, yoga studio | <https://www.retreatatthecatskills.com> |

### How to Book

1. **Visit the website** listed above.  
2. **Check availability** for your preferred dates.  
3. **Contact the retreat** via email or phone to confirm vegetarian meal options and spa services.  
4. **Reserve** your spot and pay any required deposit.

If you’d like more detailed itineraries, pricing, or alternative locations (e.g., in the Adirondacks or upstate New York), let me know and I can dig deeper!
